records.source: ``'long'`` keeps one fitted row per well-guide pair. Gene-level horseshoe rows carry all retained measured gene fractions of that complete well. Other fixed-effects LONG fits retain the gene or guide interaction. Gene-level LONG horseshoe fits weight only observation log likelihood by inverse fitted-row multiplicity per complete well, so each well contributes once without rescaling counts, exposures, design standardization or priors. ``'wide'`` pivots fractions to one row per independent well before fitting. Full gene compositions can confound a common coefficient shift with the intercept; existing estimator priors and coefficient units are retained. Mixed models keep their long nesting representation even when a wide count input was supplied.

records.translation: ``'long'``为每个孔与向导的配对保留一行拟合数据。基因级 horseshoe 行包含该完整孔中所有保留的实测基因比例。其他固定效应 LONG 拟合保留基因或向导的交互作用。基因级 LONG horseshoe 拟合仅按每个完整孔的拟合行数的倒数对观测对数似然加权，使每个孔贡献一次，而不重新缩放计数、暴露量、设计标准化或先验分布。``'wide'``在拟合前将比例透视为每个独立孔一行。完整基因组成可能使共同的系数偏移与截距混淆；保留估计器现有的先验分布和系数单位。即使输入计数采用宽格式，混合模型仍保留其长格式嵌套表示。
